lines.text: Many learners say: I didn't went there.
Go! She didn't go to school.

native.tip: بعد didn't نستخدم الفعل الأصلي: “I didn't go there.” وليس “I didn't went there.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “I didn't went there.” 😅 بعد didn't نستخدم الفعل الأصلي، فالجملة الصحيحة “I didn't go there.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “I didn't went there”?
en.tip: After didn't we use the base verb: “I didn't go there.” not “I didn't went there.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I didn't went there.” 😅 After didn't we use the base verb, so the right sentence is “I didn't go there.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
